pages.purpose: Let internal triage agents view the active/recently updated ticket queue and select a ticket to triage.

data_requirements.name: triage_queue_tickets
data_requirements.description: List of active or recently updated tickets filtered by required since_date and optional limit.

data_requirements.name: since_date_filter
data_requirements.description: User-provided or app-default ISO-8601 timestamp required by the API.

user_actions.description: Adjust the lower bound timestamp for recently updated tickets.
Adjust maximum number of tickets returned within API bounds 1-200.
Re-fetch the queue with current filters.
Navigate to /tickets/:ticketNumber for a selected ticket.

loading_states.description: Show page skeleton/table loader while first queue request is in progress.
Keep current rows visible with inline loading indicator while refetching after filter changes.

error_states.ui_response: Show inline form validation/error banner explaining since_date must be valid ISO-8601 and limit must be within bounds.

error_states.when: Queue request fails for any non-400 reason or network error.

error_states.ui_response: Show empty state indicating no tickets matched the selected since_date.

pages.purpose: Provide a destination for triaging a selected ticket, while transparently reflecting that the current backend contract does not expose ticket detail, AI guidance, similar-ticket lookup, or triage update APIs.

data_requirements.name: selected_ticket_summary
data_requirements.description: Optional ticket summary passed from queue navigation state only; not reload-safe.

data_requirements.name: ticket_detail
data_requirements.description: Needed to support full triage workflow, but no API endpoint exists in current contract.

data_requirements.name: ai_guidance
data_requirements.description: Needed for AI-assisted triage, but no API endpoint exists in current contract.

data_requirements.name: similar_tickets
data_requirements.description: Needed for similar-ticket lookup, but no API endpoint exists in current contract.

user_actions.description: Navigate back to the triage queue.
See the selected ticket number and any queue summary passed in navigation state.

loading_states.description: No API-driven loading on this page under current contract.

error_states.when: User expects ticket detail, AI guidance, or similar tickets.
error_states.ui_response: Show explicit unsupported-feature panel stating these capabilities are in POV scope but not available from the current API contract.

error_states.when: User lands directly on the route without navigation state.
error_states.ui_response: Show ticket number from URL and explain that no backend detail endpoint exists to hydrate the page.

pages.purpose: Represent the fix-validation use case in navigation, while making clear that the current API contract exposes no endpoints to list fixes, create validations, configure timeout margin, or view validation results.

data_requirements.name: fixes
data_requirements.description: Would be needed to choose a fix to validate, but no endpoint exists.

data_requirements.name: fix_validation_runs
data_requirements.description: Would be needed to review or initiate validations, but no endpoint exists.

data_requirements.name: timeout_margin_settings
data_requirements.description: Would be needed to support generous timeout margin configuration, but no endpoint exists.

user_actions.description: Review message about missing backend support for this workflow.

loading_states.description: No fetches possible with current API contract.

error_states.when: User attempts to perform fix validation tasks.
error_states.ui_response: Show unsupported-feature panel enumerating missing API endpoints for fixes and fix_validations.

components.description: Global application frame with navigation and page content area.
Top-level navigation linking to Triage Queue and Fix Validation.
Consistent page title and description area.
Controls for since_date and limit with client-side validation matching API rules.
Tabular list of tickets with clickable rows.
Skeleton rows shown while ticket list loads.
Inline validation or API error messaging.
Empty-result state for no matching tickets.
Shows basic ticket information if passed from queue navigation state.
Explains that a user story is in POV scope but not implementable with current API exposure.

constraints.description: Frontend must only call endpoints present in the API contract. No ticket detail, AI guidance, similar-ticket lookup, fix, or fix_validation endpoints currently exist.
GET /tickets requires since_date; frontend must always supply it.
limit must stay within 1-200; since_date must be valid ISO-8601 date-time.
Where POV scope exceeds API support, UI must communicate unsupported capability rather than implying functionality.
